title: The Local Operator Moment Problem on $\mathbb{R}$
summary: We study the connections between operator moment sequences ${\mathcal T}=\displaystyle(T_n)_{n\in\mathbb{Z}_+}$ of self-adjoint operators on a complex Hilbert space $\mathcal{H}$ and the local moment sequences $\langle{\mathcal T}x,x\rangle = (\langle T_nx,x\rangle)_{n\in\mathbb{Z}_+}$ for arbitrary $x\in \mathcal{H}$. We provide necessary and sufficient conditions for solving the operator moment problem on $\mathbb{R}$, and we show that these criteria are automatically valid on compact subsets of $\mathbb{R}$.
